text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about it. Just a hunch,
but deep down, I felt it this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, this world I'm in—
feels like 'something is wrong.'"
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is decided! The winner is Meisho!
The winner is Meisho!
The winner is Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring) is decided! I stand at the pinnacle!
Singing proudly the 'Song of the Shield'!
It's Meisho Doto!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nwoh, why!? Why do I always lose
to Dotou in the races that matter most?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “Ah! 'If only Doto weren't around,' my fans would sigh with pity—a tragic hero Overlord, that is me!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, buuut, there's no way
I could win this much~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Could this mean... we're...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ohh, could this mean that we...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: We swapped bodies—?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Yet I just couldn't wake up from the dream...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Doto-senpai! 'Sup!
I saw your race the other day!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Charging right into the pack and forcing a path open like that,
that's totally insane! So freakin' cool!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No way. Me, cool? Not at all~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A splendid achievement, Meisho Doto.
I am glad to be able to stand
shoulder to shoulder with you like this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Eventually, in future generations, we will be spoken of as equals. People will always talk, wondering, "Which one of them was truly stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!?
T-That is far too gracious of you~!
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: Doto! Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What is all this commotion~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, here she comes! The star of the parade,
Meisho Doto! It's Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, both the Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho, the two grand prix of Takarazuka and Arima,
and conquering the Japan Cup to top it off!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Because of her phenomenal record,
people call her this!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: —"The Turn-of-the-Century Raging Wave"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaaah,
n-n-n-not at all~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Traaaaiiiineeeer!
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Come over here!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Phew, what a relief...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Everything's fine now... Wait, huh~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou? Dotou?
Pull yourself together, Dotou."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hu... Opera O-san.
Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...
You finally realized."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... so it was... a dream...
Phew, thank goodness~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You really gave me a fright, passing out
right in the middle of a parade held in your honor.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek, so it really wasn't a dream~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, there is no need to be so timid, is there?
After all, you are now the Great King reigning above even myself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Take pride in the great feat you've accomplished,
and stand tall with confidence.
—My dear, respected Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh... Respect...?
choice_data_list: Even if it's tough, I'll be right there to support you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Then I... really have become an Umamusume
that everyone thinks is amazing, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It feels kind of strange~. But,
being respected by Opera O-san
does make me pretty happy~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case, I want to do my best from now on
as someone everyone can look up to~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll win lots and lots, as much as I can!
So I can become a star, a super-duper Umamusume!!
Yes, this is no dream. It is, without a doubt, a true history where raw talent has brilliantly blossomed.
